documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Disclosures under Reg. 29(2) of SEBI (SAST) Regulations, 2011
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation

analysis.summary: Tech Mahindra reported a strong Q2 FY27 with revenues at $1.693 billion, marking 7.2% year-on-year growth in constant currency, and operating margins reaching 14.8%. Total deal wins stood at $1.023 billion, and the board recommended a 1:1 bonus share issue alongside an interim dividend of INR 15 per share. Management highlighted broad-based growth across verticals like Communications and Retail, and detailed ongoing AI advancements under Project Helix. The company reiterated its full-year FY27 EBIT margin target of 15%. Tech Mahindra reported its audited consolidated and standalone financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.

guidance.claim: The company reiterated its full-year FY27 EBIT margin target of 15%.
guidance.quote: We reiterate that we remain on track to achieve our full-year FY27 EBIT margin target of 15%.

demand_outlook.claim: Management expects normal seasonality for the second half of the year.
Management sees a positive outlook for the healthcare sector driven by recent wins.
demand_outlook.quote: We continue to see, like we were seeing in our healthcare business, a positive outlook towards that sector again driven by some of the wins that we've had.

margins_costs.claim: Operating margins for the quarter stood at 14.8%.
margins_costs.quote: Operating margins for the quarter stood at 14.8%.

margins_costs.claim: EBIT for the quarter was US$250 million with an EBIT margin of 14.8%.
margins_costs.quote: EBIT for the quarter stood at US$250 million with an EBIT margin of 14.8%, up 40 basis points on a Q-o-Q basis and 260 basis points on a Y-o-Y basis.

margins_costs.claim: EBIT margin for the quarter was reported at 14.8%, reflecting an increase of approximately 40 basis points quarter-on-quarter and 260 basis points year-on-year.
margins_costs.quote: • EBIT Margin 14.8%, up ~40 bps QoQ, up ~260 bps YoY

margins_costs.claim: CFO Rohit Anand stated that margins expanded for the twelfth consecutive quarter, reflecting disciplined execution.
margins_costs.quote: “We delivered another strong quarter of growth, with margins expanding for the twelfth consecutive quarter, reflecting disciplined execution.

margins_costs.claim: Operating margins for the quarter stood at 14.4%, reflecting execution discipline and operational rigor.
margins_costs.quote: Operating margins stood at 14.4%, reflecting sustained execution discipline, operational rigor, and a continuous focus on profitable growth.

margins_costs.claim: EBIT margins for the quarter were at 14.4%, up 60 bps quarter-on-quarter and 330 basis points year-on-year.
margins_costs.quote: EBIT margins for the quarter were at US$238 million with EBIT percent at 14.4%, up 60 bps Q-o-Q and 330 basis points Y-o-Y.

orders_capacity.claim: Total deal wins for the quarter were US$1.023 billion.
orders_capacity.quote: Coming to deal wins, our total deal wins for the quarter were US$1.023 billion.

orders_capacity.claim: New deal wins total contract value reached $1,023 million, representing a 25.4% increase year-on-year.
orders_capacity.quote: • New deal wins TCV $1,023 mn, up 25.4% YoY

orders_capacity.claim: CEO Mohit Joshi noted that deal wins exceeded $1 billion in each of the last four quarters.
orders_capacity.quote: “Deal wins exceeding $1+ billion in each of the last four quarters reflect the strength of our customer relationships and the trust we have built.

capital_allocation.claim: The board recommended a bonus share issue in a ratio of 1:1.
capital_allocation.quote: As we mark this milestone, I'm also pleased to announce that our Board of Directors has recommended a bonus share issue in a ratio of 1:1 for our shareholders.

capital_allocation.claim: The company generated US$135 million of free cash flow during the quarter.
capital_allocation.quote: We generated US$135 million of free cash flow during the quarter.

capital_allocation.claim: Management reiterated its stance to maintain 90% to 100% free cash flow to PAT on a full-year basis.
capital_allocation.quote: We reiterate our stance to maintain 90% to 100% free cash flow to PAT on a full-year basis.

capital_allocation.claim: The board declared an interim dividend of INR15 per share.
capital_allocation.quote: The board has declared an interim dividend of INR15 per share, reaffirming our commitment to the laid-out capital allocation policy of returning 85% and above of free cash flow back to shareholders.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board declared an interim dividend of Rs. 15 per equity share of the face value of Rs. 5 each for the financial year 2026-27.
capital_allocation.quote: Declared Interim Dividend of Rs. 15/- per equity share of the face value of Rs. 5/- each (300%) for the Financial Year 2026-27.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board recommended the issue of bonus equity shares in the ratio of 1:1.
capital_allocation.quote: Issue of Bonus Equity Shares in the ratio of 1:1, i.e. one (1) new fully paid-up Bonus Equity Share of Rs. 5/- each for every one (1) existing fully paid-up equity share of Rs. 5/- each

capital_allocation.claim: The Board approved an increase in the authorized share capital of the company from Rs. 924.3 crore to Rs. 1,000 crore.
capital_allocation.quote: Increase in the Authorised Share Capital of the Company from Rs. 924.3 crore to Rs. 1,000 crore, and consequent amendment to the existing Clause V(a) of the Memorandum of Association of the Company.

capital_allocation.claim: The company generated US$167 million of free cash flow during the quarter, up 94% year-on-year.
capital_allocation.quote: We generated US$167 million of free cash flow during the quarter, up 94% on a Y-o-Y basis.

risks_headwinds.claim: A sequential revenue headwind in manufacturing is expected in Q3 as well.
risks_headwinds.quote: A sequential revenue headwind associated with the program is expected in Q3 as well, though to a much smaller extent.

risks_headwinds.claim: The European auto segment had a one-off in this quarter that will show signs of slowdown in Q2.
risks_headwinds.quote: The one sort of headwind that we will have is the fact that we had a one-off in our European auto business in this quarter, which will show some signs of slowdown then in Q2.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to introduce AI revenue reporting as part of its H2 FY27 disclosures.
management_commitments.quote: We expect to introduce AI revenue reporting as part of our H2 FY27 disclosures and continue it on an ongoing basis, refining the methodology as our portfolio and the markets mature.

management_commitments.claim: The interim dividend shall be paid by November 13, 2026.
management_commitments.quote: The Interim Dividend shall be paid by 13 November 2026 through electronic mode to those Members or their mandates

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
